data.long_meaning: Musarat is a name derived from the Arabic language. It means 'delight' or 'pleasure'. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's companions who found joy and satisfaction in following the teachings of Islam. The name Musarat carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musarat usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
